scope: Read-only source, card, and existing toy-receipt review; no reviewer experiments or real model forwards

stimulus_contract_revision.decision: Accepted same-family revision before real execution and QGT inspection; does not add a method
stimulus_contract_revision.new_contract: Foreground probe is the complete known-MR bounding box plus fixed16pixel natural context, as a rectangular RGB crop. Negative replaces only known-MR pixels with nearest known-reference-background RGB. Outside-MR pixels are byte-identical before the same crop/resize.
stimulus_contract_revision.old_failure: Grey alpha-masked negative preserved the foreground silhouette, so it did not justify an object-absence interpretation. Old toy receipt is retained as old_rgba_toy_report.json.
stimulus_contract_revision.remaining_limit: Nearest-background replacement may still leave shape, seam, and texture artifacts. It is known-foreground pixel replacement, not a guarantee that DINO perceives semantic object absence.

source_audit: All panel differences read only48 upper token rows whose main RGB is identical across conditions; the48row reference mask is transformed through the same main-window geometry and the complete field maps back to64 query rows.
Quadrant intervention preserves each scored512pixel quadrant at its original position, covers every native token once, and compares with the same original1024 producer/geometry.
Mixed raw-feature difference is evaluated before feature unit normalization, has a declared nominal subtraction guard, and does not claim that guard certifies model-forward error.

Position orbit re-encodes physical patch-aligned RGB rolls and inverse maps the resulting token grid. Pixel bytes are preserved, but seam/context and position effects are explicitly not causally separated.

Small complete-result group caching computes same-view controls while adapter views remain cached. It does not create an unbounded second feature cache; the declared worst-case maximum is28 additional views per episode.
Registered methods and controls produce complete signed margins. Missing legal RGB/reference mask/encoder origin is explicit, rather than pretending cached origin features are new forwards.

receipt_review.source_binding: Receipt code SHA equals the reviewed source SHA
receipt_review.scope: Pixel-derived stipulated encoders demonstrate possible decision changes and counterexamples, not an actual DINO response or gain. They are not a proof that frozen DINO has the stipulated interaction.
receipt_review.positive_full_mask_examples: Remote1.0, mixed competition1.0, orbit1.0; external sensitivity0.25 versus mean0 and vector0.0833. Each has an explicit echo/additive/style/seam negative.
receipt_review.mapping_audits: Four preserved quadrants and RGB inverse rolls pass recorded byte audits; reference main-mask coverage sum closes exactly. All-methods-then-controls toy callback attempts21 are below the28 cap, with zero real forwards.

nonblocking_declaration_issue.observed_source: The control averages the whole bottom16x64 token panel per view, including neutral canvas, then matches upper query tokens to foreground/background panel averages.
nonblocking_declaration_issue.required_claim_limit: Describe this as whole-panel average matching. It is not a reproduction of ProM4 or an actual inserted-object-only token control. A proper inserted-area control can reuse the same encodings; no extra model forwards are needed.

current_real_probe_limit: Latest card records root authorization for one fixed first episode only, not automatic4/200 expansion. Root owns scheduling, resource monitoring, and any extension decision.
delivery_limit: Card/source eligibility is not completed real output, actual cost, natural benefit, or completion of100 methods. Root tracks the final fixed-source delivery inventory.
